videos.title: Cem Karsan Called for a 25 to 40% Decline, and He Still Does
videos.description:
A big, specific call he's willing to be held to: Cem Karsan has publicly said he expects a 25 to 40% decline between November and June, with the most likely window December into January. The mechanism matters more than the number. Bad news takes months to actually move markets because the open interest and hedging sit further out. Everybody knew about COVID in December and the market didn't roll over until February expiration.
